description: This file is a Swift extension on the ProcessInfo class, adding computed properties and a static method to determine runtime modes such as preview mode, nix mode, and whether tests are running. It leverages environment variables, UserDefaults, and bundle information to infer these states.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: A class providing runtime process information, extended here with additional properties and methods to determine specific runtime states.

methods.name: resolveNixMode
methods.description: A static method to determine if nix mode is active based on environment variables, user defaults, and application bundle context.
